Identify S3 Email change as implicit under Opening day's Member profile maintenance, citing the source and broader bullet.
Account for S4 Deposit refund as excluded by D1, citing D1; do not report it as a gap.
Identify Weather forecast widget as an unsupported Lending desk bullet by name, with its plan anchor and explanation of missing authoritative backing.
Ledger accounts for S1-S5 exactly once; headline counts match rows. S1 and S5 are explicit in Opening day. Additional unsupported bullets are allowed and counted separately.
Produce two milestone assessments and a merged report with citations, confidence, decisions, and known limitations; no tracker use, ticket-existence claims, or implementation tasks.

Identify S1 and S5 as explicit and S3 Email change as implicit under Member profile maintenance, with citations.
Explicitly state Whole-SoW completeness was not assessed and global sweep/historical reconciliation was not performed; do not present a claimed-items sweep as global completeness.

expectations.assertion: One ledger accounts for S1-S12 exactly once with separate document/Jira coverage and citations. S2 Loan history is absent in the document but ticketed by DEMO-9; Jira analysis must not be limited to document gaps.
S6 Overdue alerts is partial via DEMO-3: email covered, SMS excluded by the ticket but still authoritative scope. No other ticket covers SMS; do not let ticket exclusions remove requirements.

S7 Equipment reservations is ticketed jointly by DEMO-4 and DEMO-11 across releases. Count once. Name a bundled-ticket finding for closed DEMO-5 covering S8 Loan CSV export and S9 Staff edit audit log. Do not claim implemented or unimplemented behavior.
S4 Deposit refund remains excluded with D1 citation; not a Jira gap.

S10 Screen reader navigation has no ticket: DEMO-6 title is a false match, complete body covers weather styling. S11 Late fee calculation has no covering ticket and is deferred by DEMO-7 without a destination. Cite full-content search evidence, scope and snapshot; both are named gaps.

Read companion details-8.json before calling S12 Hold notification ticketed. Search's omitted description is not empty content or evidence of absence. All pages and descriptions are available in this case.
Release versions define milestones, not DEMO-100 epic. S1,S3,S5 have Jira content coverage. S2 is in Lending desk. Unsupported weather scope is surfaced without inflated inventory counts.

S1,S3,S5 cite DEMO-1,10,2 respectively. Version-based selection does not include every child of DEMO-100.
